story_description: Implement all settings category views and their entry points.
task_description: Users need to configure chat behavior including default model, thinking level, temperature, send key, and cost display.
atom_description: Users need to configure chat behavior including default model, thinking level, temperature, send key, and cost display.
problem_statement: Users need to configure chat behavior including default model, thinking level, temperature, send key, and cost display.
scope_in: Model picker; thinking level slider (0-3); temperature slider; top-p slider; send key toggle; cost display toggle; sycophancy stripping toggle
Implement ChatSettingsView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Model API configuration; actual chat behavior implementation
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
functional_requirements: Model picker with available models (opus, sonnet, haiku)
nonfunctional_requirements: Must not block the main UI thread.
api_contracts: Primary API surface is the ChatSettingsView.swift type and its public members.
Public APIs match Swift naming conventions and are documented in code comments.
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_interactions: Drag temperature slider → Value updates live
ui_copy: Send key options: "Enter to send", "Cmd+Enter to send"
edge_cases: Model not available - show as disabled
Missing dependencies should fall back to safe defaults without crashing.
failure_modes: Invalid AppStorage value - reset to default
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Remove view; chat uses hardcoded defaults

unit: Unit test core logic for ChatSettingsView.swift with representative inputs.

integration: Integration test ChatSettingsView.swift with dependent stores or managers.
ui: Verify SwiftUI previews render without crash.
perf: Ensure settings changes apply without visible jank.
security: Ensure no sensitive data is logged.
Verify file permissions for any on-disk artifacts.
